title: Hear the changes glide
prompt: C.C. Rider — the right hand never jumps. Listen for how the chords melt into each other.

generatorParams.promptText: Every change moves one or two fingers by a step — that's voice leading. The hand stays home; the harmony travels.

title: Same chord, new stack
prompt: Inversions: why C-E-G, E-G-C and G-C-E are one chord — and why the nearest stack wins.
successRule: Answer all 5 correctly — a slip means a replay.

title: Build them anywhere
prompt: C, F, G7 — any stack counts. Build each one WITHOUT jumping: use the shape nearest to where your hand already is.
successRule: Build all 6 correctly — a slip means a replay.

title: Home or leaning? (refresher)
prompt: Before the changes get fast, re-tune the ear: plain major, or the buzzing dominant 7th?
successRule: Name all 6 correctly — a slip means a replay.

title: C to F — hold the common tone
prompt: C to F/C and back — thumb stays planted on C, two fingers slide a step.
successRule: Every note right — a slip means a replay.

title: C to G7 — the leading tone
prompt: C to G7/B and back — the bottom finger drops a half-step to B, then leans home.
successRule: Every note right — a slip means a replay.

title: Comp the whole form
prompt: All twelve bars of changes, nearest shapes only — count the form as you go.
successRule: Every note right — a slip means a replay.

title: Eyes on the symbols
prompt: No falling notes — the simplified C.C. Rider from the chord symbols, melody and roots.
successRule: Earn at least one star from the symbols alone — every note right; a slip means a replay.

title: Changes without stopping
prompt: The full C.C. Rider — inversion comping over steady roots. If a shape escapes you, keep the pulse and catch the next change.
successRule: Every note right and the pulse never breaks — a stop means a replay.

title: Checkpoint: smooth changes
prompt: The Tier 9 cross-strand check — inversions, voice leading, harmonic rhythm, playing through a miss.
successRule: Answer all 6 correctly — a slip means a replay.

title: Performance: C.C. Rider
prompt: The Tier 9 boss: the full C.C. Rider at 88 BPM, unassisted — and the pulse never stops.
successRule: Earn the mastery star with an unbroken pulse: three stars at tempo, no assists, no stops — every note right; a slip means a replay.

title: Boss Challenge: Pinetop's changes
prompt: The I-IV-V you now glide through, inside a boogie fifteen tiers up. Just explore.
successRule: No stars, no failure — chase the changes and see what sticks.
